rationale: The apparent 7.59x relative volume is an artifact of a single one-minute print of ~907k shares at an unchanged 49.26 — a block/crossing print, not directional order flow — while organic volume in surrounding minutes is only a few hundred shares. Price is pinned to VWAP within a ~14-cent daily range with 1.9-cent 5m ATR, no news catalyst, and flat behavior that is uninformative against a risk-off tape, so there is no mechanical edge in either direction and any stop would sit inside noise with thin real liquidity to exit against.
